chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Himyari from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ali, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Riaab, from Abu Ubaydah al-Hadda' who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:

When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) conquered Mecca, he stood on Safa and said: O sons of Hashim, O sons of Abd al-Muttalib, I am the Messenger of Allah to you, and I am affectionate towards you. Do not say that Muhammad is from among us; by Allah, my allies are not from you nor from others, except the God-fearing.
So, I will not recognize you when you come to me on the Day of Resurrection carrying the world on your necks, while people come carrying the Hereafter.
Indeed, I have made my excuse regarding what is between me and you, and what is between Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and you. And I have my deeds, and you have your deeds.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: My allies/followers, referring to those close to the Prophet in faith
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: The worldly life, often contrasted with the Hereafter
key_terms.الْآخِرَةُ: The Hereafter, the eternal life after death
key_terms.اَلصَّفَا: Safa, a hill in Mecca where the Prophet stood to deliver his address
key_terms.بَنُو عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ: Banu Abd al-Muttalib, the broader clan of the Prophet
key_terms.بَنُو هَاشِمٍ: Banu Hashim, the clan of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (s) warn the Banu Hashim about on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Sifat al-Shia*, this hadith highlights the transitioned from the conquest of Mecca to emphasize that prophetic intercession is not automatic for the Prophet's clan but contingent upon piety (*taqwa*). It serves as a foundational Shia principle distinguishing between biological lineage and spiritual affinity, warning that on Judgment Day, the Banu Hashim will carry the weight of the world if they lack righteousness, while the true allies carry the Hereafter.

en.badr-shahin: Mohammed bin Musa bin al-Mutawakkil, Allah may have mercy upon him, narrated to us from Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari from Ahmed bin Mohammed bin Easa from al-Hasan bin Mahboub from Ali bin Riaab from Abu Ubaida al-Hetthaa that Abu Abdullah (a) related that

when the Prophet (s) conquered Mecca, he stood in Safa and said: O sons of Hashim and sons of Abdul-Muttalib, I am the messenger of Allah to all of you. I feel pity for you. Do not depend on the fact that Mohammed is from you. By Allah I swear, my followers, whether they are from your clan or any other clan, are only the God-fearing.
I will not admit you on the Day of Resurrection if you come to me burdened with the worldly disadvantages while others come with the advantages of the world to come.
I am excused regarding my mission to you and the commandments of Allah for you. I have my own deeds and you will have your own deeds.
